verdict.rationale: Vestd lists "Share certificates" as a feature, documents digital share issuance with no paperwork, and offers in-platform deed/witness signatures. However, the certificate mention is only a bare heading, and nothing ties signatures to certificates or shows a permanent link to cap table entries. missing for 10: documentation that certificates are generated electronically on issuance, evidence that certificates are legally signed in-platform, evidence of a permanent certificate-to-cap-table-entry link, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can issue electronic share certificates that are legally signed in-platform and permanently linked to the cap table entry they represent

citations.quote: Board-ready equity governance and reporting, with deed / witness signatures and custom document templates.
Authorise and issue new shares digitally, and update Companies House in the click of a button. No paperwork involved!
